narrative: 选择、悔恨、漫画式的信息过载：两三个世界共享同一个画面，身份被锁定，这样这个笑点才不会变成一堆陌生人。建筑可以带着变化重复出现。
每一个副本都拥有一个完整的世界，而不只是一个幽灵般的残影。一场诚实的单一场景不需要副本。
当你无法说清这些世界分别是什么时，它就是错误的工具；当失败没有任何代价时，也是错误的用法。复杂度不能替代知道选错门要付出什么代价这件事。
how: 锁定一个能容纳两三种不同布局的画面：分裂的建筑、层叠的房间，或重复的走廊。同一张脸，不同的服装和色调，五官不要混淆。
明确定义进入和退出的信号。Prompt: Multiverse split of [Subject], many versions, many grades, the same person in parallel rooms.
when: 一个分岔的选择、一段展现另一种人生的悔恨、漫画式的自我信息过载。不要用在已经是一个诚实房间的场景上。
vs: 同屏分身（Duplication）是多个副本，但每个副本没有各自的世界。分屏（Split Screen）是能把不同版本分隔开的剪辑法则。
多元宇宙需要各不相同的色调和房间，身份保持锁定。如果你说不清这些世界是什么，你拍出来的只是一堆幽灵。
examples_film: 《瞬息全宇宙》（Everything Everywhere All at Once）把不同的人生以服装和色调的方式一一清点。《奇异博士》（Doctor Strange）构建了平行的房间。
《盗梦空间》（Inception）、《感官游戏》（eXistenZ）和《红辣椒》（Paprika）把规则层层嵌套，让一次出口也可能是假的。借鉴的是这种平行法则，而不是某一帧画面。
mistakes: 双重曝光式的糊成一团，或看起来像陌生人的副本。破绽是脸被混合在一起，以及说不清是什么的世界。
修正方法：可以分辨的版本、锁定的身份，以及选错门会带来的代价。

faq.q: 电影中的多元宇宙（Multiverse）是什么？
faq.a: 一种平行清单式的风格：同一个人同时出现在各不相同的房间、色调和服装中。每个副本都拥有一个世界。糊成一团就是失败。

faq.q: 多元宇宙（Multiverse）与分屏（Split Screen）的区别
faq.a: 分屏是一种能展现两个动作的画面分割方式。多元宇宙则是内容层面的法则：平行的人生、各不相同的色调、同一个身份。你可以用分屏来承载它，但单靠分屏并不等于这个风格。

faq.q: 什么时候该用多元宇宙？
faq.a: 选择、悔恨、漫画式的信息过载。跳过一场诚实的单一场景，也跳过没有失败代价的谜题。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写多元宇宙的提示词？
faq.a: 先锁定身份，然后明确说出两三个可以分辨的世界。不要让脸混在一起。

narrative: Choice, regret, comic overload: two or three worlds sharing a frame, identity locked so the gag is not strangers. Architecture can repeat with variations.
Each copy has a world, not just a ghost. A single honest scene does not need copies.
It is the wrong tool when you cannot name the worlds, or when failure has no stake. Complexity is not a substitute for knowing what a wrong door costs.
how: Lock a frame that can hold two or three distinct setups: split architecture, layered rooms, or repeating corridors. Same face, different wardrobe and grade, no mixed features.
Define entry and exit cues. Prompt: Multiverse split of [Subject], many versions, many grades, the same person in parallel rooms.
when: A choice that forks, a regret that shows the other life, comic overload of selves. Do not use it on a scene that is already one honest room.
vs: Duplication is extra copies without a world each. Split Screen is the cut law that can hold versions apart.
Multiverse needs distinct grades and rooms, identity locked. If you cannot name the worlds, you shot ghosts.
examples_film: Everything Everywhere All at Once inventories lives as costume and grade. Doctor Strange builds parallel rooms.
Inception, eXistenZ, and Paprika nest rules so an exit may be fake. Borrow the parallel law, not a frame.
mistakes: Double-exposure mush, or copies that look like strangers. The tell is blended faces and unnamed worlds.
Fix it: separable versions, locked identity, a stake if a door is wrong.

faq.a: A parallel-inventory look: the same person in distinct rooms, grades, and costumes at once. Each copy has a world. Mush is failure.

Split screen is a frame division that can show two actions. Multiverse is the content law: parallel lives, distinct grades, one identity. You can use split screen to hold it, but split screen alone is not the look.
Choice, regret, comic overload. Skip a single honest scene, and skip puzzles with no cost of failure.

faq.q: How do I prompt Multiverse for AI image or video?
faq.a: Lock identity, then: Multiverse split of [Subject], many versions, many grades, the same person in parallel rooms. Name two or three separable worlds. No blended faces.
